isolation: Temporary SQLite, media and copied content snapshots; localhost ephemeral HTTP; .env hidden; browser external requests blocked; no production writes.

checks.name: Management requires authentication and new drafts remain private until publication
Editing collected profiles persists original prose, preserves public drafts and follows untouched collector fields
Archive hides collected profiles without deleting drafts, and explicit republishing restores them
Athlete administrator creates and previews a complete article, saves a draft, then publishes and edits it
Collector conflicts preserve local prose while merging the newest untouched season and PB results
Pacer administrator publishes one person with multiple race assignments and truthful service badges
Editing an existing H:MM pacer article preserves target time, pace and collected assignment evidence
Mobile editors and public readers retain complete articles without horizontal overflow or external source links

limitations: Chromium mobile viewports do not replace WeChat device testing.
All newly authored people and race assignments are disposable acceptance fixtures.
